label: id
comment: A unique identifier (URI) assigned to the product passport. May be a UUID
The globally unique ID of this conformity attestation.
A linked data URL for the entity (product, facility, or organisation) that is identified by this identifier - eg https://abr.business.gov.au/ABN/View?abn=90664869327
A unique identifier for the standard (eg https://www.iso.org/standard/60857.html).

domainIncludes.comment: A conformity attestation issued by a competent body that defines one or more assessments (eg carbon intensity) about a product (eg batttery) against a specification (eg LCA method) defined in a standard or regulation.

A conformity attestation issued by a competent body that defines one or more assessments (eg carbon intensity) about a product (eg batttery) against a specification (eg LCA method) defined in a standard or regulation.
A formal governance scheme under which this attestation is issued (eg ACRS structural steel certification)
A specific assessment about the product or facility against a specific specification.  Eg the carbon intensity of a given product or batch.
